jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
jobs.content:
About the role

Razorpay, a full-stack fintech company, is hiring a Senior Software Development Engineer in Bengaluru to build payment infrastructure at scale, with a focus on product thinking, code quality and AI-augmented development.

Responsibilities

  • Scale Razorpay's payment infrastructure
  • Shape REST APIs used by developers worldwide
  • Drive product and design discussions

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in technology
  • Proficiency in any one of PHP, Python, Django, Golang, Java or C++
  • Strong product design sense, focused on the user
  • Good understanding of REST APIs and the web in general
  • Ability to build a feature from scratch and drive it to completion independently
  • Clean, well-structured code with awareness of performance and time complexity
  • Hands-on use of AI coding assistants and critical review of AI-generated code
  • Strong low-level design depth

Nice to have

  • Side projects or open-source contributions on GitHub
  • Prior experience at a product company
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs or agentic frameworks
  • Designing systems for scalability, reliability and fault tolerance

jobs.title: Lead Security Engineer
jobs.content:
About the role

Product Security Lead at Razorpay in Bengaluru, building Secure Code Review and Threat Modeling capabilities and a self-serve design review program.

Requirements

  • 5-8 years of experience performing Secure Code Review and Design Reviews
  • Experience working with and extending Static Analysis tools
  • Intermediate development skills, preferably in Golang or Python
  • Understanding of Microservices and Cloud architecture
  • In-depth understanding of OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities
  • Engineering degree in Computer Science or a related field

Nice to have

  • Semgrep experience
  • Master's degree

jobs.title: DevOps Enginer
jobs.content:
About the role

Permanent full-time DevOps role in Razorpay's Kuala Lumpur office, Malaysia, Monday to Friday, building and maintaining cloud infrastructure.

Requirements

  • 1-3 years of hands-on DevOps experience
  • Cloud infrastructure experience, preferably AWS
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • Building AI agents or agentic workflows for DevOps
  • Puppet, Chef or Ansible
  • Scripting in Shell, Ruby, Perl, Python or Golang
  • Linux production troubleshooting
  • Terraform

Nice to have

  • MariaDB/MySQL
  • CI/CD, logging and monitoring stacks
  • Open-source contributions
